## D — Crashes, vehicle equipment and sharing the road
Accuracy scope: Crashes, vehicle equipment and sharing the road; each fact block identifies exactly one registered physical source page.
Motorcycle operation and rider-course material are excluded; passenger-car sharing duties are included. Dated crash proportions are not current statistics. Penny-test wording describes the handbook's test criterion rather than certifying complete tire safety. The later Move Over passage retains its extra trigger conditions and separate response facts.
The author completed a semantic source-fidelity pass over every drafted fact before submission; the scratch receipts enumerate every fact identifier and verdict. This is same-model work and independent coverage and hallucination review remain pending.
Shared pages contribute noncommercial material only. Unreadable graphics are withheld; no picture-dependent rule has been reconstructed from memory.
Currency warning: applicability of the issuer-linked older edition remains source debt (verify WY-SEC11-FRESH).

verification_debt.claim_text: The issuer warns printed manual material can be outdated; refresh before asserting present-day legal applicability.
The pedestrian-fatality proportion on page 70 and heavy-vehicle crash-causation generalization on page 71 lack a current dated dataset; no present numeric or comparative crash share is asserted.

Pages 40 and 49 summarize Move Over duties differently from the fuller pages 71–72 text. Preserve the latter's active signals, vehicle speed, proximity, safe-action and road-layout conditions; no broader universal rule is inferred.
Pages 68–69 describe a tread screening procedure, not a complete evaluation of all tire conditions; no general safe-tire certification is inferred from its result.
